name: Fiji

flag.description: A light blue field with the Union Jack in the upper hoist and the shield from Fiji's coat of arms in the fly: a golden lion holding a cocoa pod above a red St George's cross, with sugar cane, a coconut palm, a dove and a bunch of bananas in the quarters.
flag.symbolism: The light blue represents the Pacific Ocean and the Union Jack Fiji's links with Britain; the shield shows the country's main crops and a dove of peace.

hook: Fiji's light-blue ensign carries a single shield with a lion, sugar cane, palm, bananas and a dove; Tuvalu's light-blue ensign has nine yellow stars instead.
trivia: In 2015 the government announced it would replace the flag to drop the Union Jack, but abandoned the plan in 2016 after a design competition.
Fiji's rugby sevens gold at the 2016 Rio Olympics was the country's first ever Olympic medal.
The 180th meridian passes through Fiji, though the International Date Line bends around the islands so the whole country shares one date.
